name: What is the difference between a custom home and a production home?
description: Custom homes are uniquely designed for an individual homeowner, while production homes are built from pre-set plans in communities.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom home and a production home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom home is uniquely designed and built to the homeowner's specific preferences, offering full control over layout, materials, and features. It typically involves an architect and a general contractor, resulting in a unique residence. A production home, on the other hand, is built by a developer in a community using pre-designed floor plans and a limited selection of finishes. While often more cost-effective and quicker to build, production homes offer less customization. Custom homes provide unparalleled personalization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom homes are uniquely designed for an individual homeowner, while production homes are built from pre-set plans in communities.
